bound_directions.D_rule: MVT: (gamma(s)-gamma(t))/(t-s) = |gamma'(xi)| >= inf over [s_lo,t_hi]; (1+ab) >= 1+(1-s_hi)(1-t_hi); product of lower bounds of nonnegative quantities
bound_directions.L5: numerator N is increasing so N(l) is its minimum; denominator pi_d h(pi_d) <= pi_d(r) * max h on the image interval
bound_directions.N0: numerator uses -log(1-pi)>=pi and pi_d'>=2x(2-3x0); denominator uses h(pi)<=pi(log(1/pi)+1), pi_d<=2x^2, u(log(1/u)+1) increasing, x(2log(1/x)+c) increasing below exp(-(1+log2)/2)
bound_directions.N1: numerator uses pi_d'>=pi_d'(x1) on [x1,1] (x1>=3/4) and ell/(ell+1) increasing; denominator uses pi<=1 and h(pi)<=(1-pi)(log(1/(1-pi))+1)
bound_directions.Q_rule: gamma(s)>=gamma(s_hi), gamma(t)<=gamma(t_lo) (gamma decreasing), 0<t-s<=t_hi-s_lo; requires s_hi<t_lo so the numerator lower bound is positive
bound_directions.identity_middle_term: dropped term is (log(1+delta)-M_mu)/2*(Lam_st+Lbar) with log(1+delta)>=0, -M_mu>=0 (L0f), Lam>=0 (L0g): dropping it lowers Phi
bound_directions.sinh: sinh x >= x for x >= 0 gives kappa_sinh >= kappa/2; used in L2 only

L0a_derivative_identity.algebra: u*h' = u log(1-u) - u log u; -h = u log u + (1-u) log(1-u); sum = log(1-u)
L0a_derivative_identity.statement: u*h'(u) - h(u) == log(1-u); hence Lam'(u) = log(1-u)/u^2 < 0

L0b_pi_d_monotone.proof: discriminants 9-16=-7<0 and 9-12=-3<0 with positive leading coefficients

L0c_gamma_decreasing.proof: Lam' < 0 by L0a, pi_d' > 0 by L0b, chain rule
L0c_gamma_decreasing.statement: g = Lam o pi_d and gamma = log g are strictly decreasing on (0,1); gamma' = log(1-pi_d) pi_d' /(pi_d h(pi_d))

L0d_mu_shape.proof: -(1-u)log(1-u) = u - sum_{k>=2} u^k/(k(k-1)) by multiplying the log series by (1-u); all derivative coefficients are negative on (0,1); mu(1)=0 by continuity; mu>=0 since -(1-u)log(1-u)>=0
L0d_mu_shape.statement: mu(u) = 1 - sum_{k>=2} u^{k-1}/(k(k-1)); mu decreasing, concave, 0<=mu<=1 on [0,1]

L0e_polynomial_identity.degree_bound: <= 4 in each variable, so a 5x5 grid already suffices

L0f_M_mu_nonpositive.proof: L0e gives pi_st <= sqrt(pi_ss pi_tt) <= (pi_ss+pi_tt)/2; mu decreasing then mu concave (L0d)

L1_identity.status: MACHINE-VERIFIED at the listed rational points; the identity itself is the algebra in the module docstring (L1)

L2_master.proof: drop the nonnegative middle term of L1; g(s)-g(t) = 2 sqrt(g(s)g(t)) sinh((gamma(s)-gamma(t))/2); sinh x >= x for x >= 0
L2_master.statement: for 0<s<t<1, Phi >= s^2 t^2 (s-t)^2 g(s) g(t) (kappa^2/4 - 1); kappa>=2 implies Phi>=0

L3_boundary.statement: Phi(s,s)=0; Phi(0,t)=0; Phi(s,1)=h(s)^2>=0 since pi(s,1)=s and pi(1,1)=1; Phi symmetric
